notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

The first patch for Antisphere is now live! Thank you all for your detailed reports and patience. Here is the list of things that was fixed with this patch:

- the game now properly responds to input on lower frame rate
- fixed a bug where the game could enter a singleplayer challenge by mouse clicking the level name
- fixed an issue where the game would not accept input when the player enters Singleplayer Tutorials or Challenges with keyboard + mouse
- fixed an issue where the singleplayer tutorial would display controller information when entered with mouse and keyboard
- fixed pause menu mouse hover issues
- fixed an issue where the mouse would not be locked to the game window when playing singleplayer challenges, local and online matches
- UX - changed the "Next Challenge" button in singleplayer challenges from Enter to Space
- UX - changed the "Replay" button in singleplayer challenges from Alt to R
- UX - changed the Singleplayer Menu hover and click button colors
- reworked the Loadout menu to be consistent with the rest of the menus
- fixed an issue where the number, cooldown, duration and description of items would be incorrect in the Loadout menu
- made the "Take it easy" achievement easier to unlock
- fixed minor localization issues in the French language
- fixed several mistakes with the English UI text
- fixed loop times for some in-game music tracks
- changed how the mouse sensitivity works in-game

Vedran, Community Moderator
Soap Interactive
